mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing amiodarone levels; both agents have antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for amiodarone toxicity (QT prolongation, bradycardia, hepatotoxicity) and bleeding signs; consider INR monitoring if patient on warfarin; counsel on turmeric supplementation use.
